# VNyan triggers

![Adding a trigger: on the Actions page, click + Trigger and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-trigger-picker.png)

## VNyan message

Runs when VNyan's "Websocket Message" node sends text to Cuebot, so a VNyan graph (a prop hitting you, an avatar loading, a hotkey, a gesture) can start Cuebot actions. Turn on "Listen for VNyan" on the VNyan card first and put the address it shows into the node.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Commands** | Only react to these commands: the first word of the text, or the "command" or "event" of a JSON message. Separate several with commas; leave empty for every message. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%message%` | The whole text VNyan sent |
| `%vnyanCommand%` | The first word of the text, or the "command", "event", "action" or "name" of a JSON message |
| `%vnyanValue%` | The rest of the text (a number when it is one, for example 5 from "Throw 5"), or the "value" of a JSON message |
| `%vnyanJson%` | true when VNyan sent a JSON object; each of its keys is then a variable too, for example %user% |

<small>Type id: `vnyan.message`</small>
